newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet diffs steady, but Mideast barrels arriving.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet diffs steady, but Mideast barrels arriving.

text.p: NWE jet premiums held steady on Friday but were poised to weaken as cheap barrels make their way to northern Europe from the Middle East, traders said.
"The fob avails in the AG are looking very attractive," said one dealer.
Fob parcels out of the ARA region were assessed at quotes fob high +$1.50/$1.75, after a 4,000 tonne parcel traded on Thursday at Oct IPE gas oil +$30.75 a tonne fob ARA.
A French refiner bid for cif material into Bordeaux, but the premiums were not revealed.
